judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 130 to cancel a change to the federal land plan that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. The House passed it 214-212.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 130 to cancel a change to the federal land plan that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. The House passed it 214-212.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 131 to cancel the federal land agency decision limiting the coastal plain oil and gas leasing program, opening more of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to drilling. The House passed it 217-209.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 131 to cancel the federal land agency decision limiting the coastal plain oil and gas leasing program, opening more of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to drilling. The House passed it 217-209.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending S.J.Res. 80 to the President to cancel the federal land agency's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska and reopen parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. The House passed it 216-209.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending S.J.Res. 80 to the President to cancel the federal land agency's activity plan for the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska and reopen parts of the 23-million-acre reserve to oil and gas leasing. The House passed it 216-209.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 5214, which required jail before trial for violent and dangerous crimes in DC and required cash bail for release before trial in other public safety cases. The House passed it 237-179.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 5214, which required jail before trial for violent and dangerous crimes in DC and required cash bail for release before trial in other public safety cases. The House passed it 237-179.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 1949, the Unlocking our Domestic LNG Potential Act, which ended Energy Department reviews of natural gas imports and exports and put federal energy regulators alone in charge of liquefied natural gas terminal requests. The House passed it 217-188.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 1949, the Unlocking our Domestic LNG Potential Act, which ended Energy Department reviews of natural gas imports and exports and put federal energy regulators alone in charge of liquefied natural gas terminal requests. The House passed it 217-188.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 130 to the President to cancel a change to the federal land plan that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. The Senate passed it 51-43.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 130 to the President to cancel a change to the federal land plan that had ended new federal coal leasing in the Buffalo field office in Wyoming's Powder River Basin. The Senate passed it 51-43.
